A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 63-page EMAG paper, including appendices A–H. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to the first-page arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-generation experiments using SD3 and DiT, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, timing measurements, and qualitative results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original SD3 and DiT experiments, quantitative results, ablations, timing measurements, and qualitative examples.

M1.justification: The attention EMA procedure, adaptive layer selection, guidance updates, and EMAG-I and EMAG-Q variants are identical, including Algorithms 1–2 and their appendix formulations.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ImageNet and COCO 2014 coverage, including class-conditional, text-to-image, and unconditional generation. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding main and supplementary experiments, including CFG, SAG, PAG, SEG, ERG, S2, APG, and CADS where evaluated.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and the appendices retain identical model configurations, resolutions, sample counts, samplers, sampling budgets, metrics, and hyperparameter-selection procedures.

E4.justification: The same layer-selection, guidance-scale, EMA-decay, reduced-step, negative-hardness, and computational analyses remain. Their tables, plots, and qualitative examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix A and Table S22 retain the same three seeds (8, 56, 64), 1,000 samples per seed, and cross-seed standard-deviation reporting. Timing uncertainty reporting is also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 2 reports EMAG FID 22.890 and HPS 29.76 ± 0.03 in both versions; supplementary result entries are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, equations, assumptions, the Hopfield discussion, and Appendix G.1's first-order EMAG-Q approximation derivation are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about controllable hard negatives, adaptive layer selection, the +0.54 HPS improvement over CFG, and compatibility with APG and CADS.

C2.justification: Interpretations of negative hardness, guidance mechanisms, computational tradeoffs, and baseline behavior are unchanged. Appendix H retains the same applicability boundaries and limitations.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, hyperparameter tables, hardware and timing information, evaluation instructions, and the code-access link are identical. The updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later version.

R1.justification: The bibliography and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendix B are identical, including comparisons with earlier guidance methods and PLADIS.

P1.justification: The first-page marginal identification changes from v2 dated 31 Jul 2026 to v3 dated 31 Aug 2026. All paper wording, headings, and section ordering remain identical.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes font and position. The first-page body and all subsequent pages are visually identical, including every figure, table, caption, and appendix layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and exposition are identical throughout the main text and appendices. Updating and repositioning the administrative arXiv stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
